summary_en: This Phase 1/2a study tests HMPL-A580 in adults with advanced or metastatic solid tumors. The study has a dose escalation part (Part A) with 6 predefined dose levels and a dose expansion part (Part B); the route, schedule and duration are not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, immunogenicity and preliminary efficacy.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2a evalúa HMPL-A580 en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados o metastásicos. El estudio tiene una parte de escalado de dosis (Parte A) con 6 niveles de dosis predefinidos y una parte de expansión de dosis (Parte B); la vía de administración, el esquema y la duración no se indican. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética, la inmunogenicidad y la eficacia preliminar.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with histologically confirmed, unresectable, advanced or metastatic solid tumor.
At least one measurable lesion per RECIST v1.1.
Life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.
Able to understand the study and voluntarily sign the informed consent form.
not_for: Established type 1 diabetes or uncontrolled type 2 diabetes.
Use of strong CYP3A4, P-gp or BCRP inhibitors shortly before the first dose.
Major surgery within 28 days before the first dose.
Received a live product within 3 months before enrollment (type not specified in the record).
